Urgent
*   Alderbrook Gathering: Decide which customers to cut or where to buy replacement gas by 10:00 AM today due to a compressor fire causing force majeure and a loss of 30,000 MMBtu/d supply.
*   Whitlock subpoena: Submit all risk reports for March and April plus any related emails to me by noon tomorrow; do not delete anything in the meantime.
*   Fernhollow Electric: Call their dispatcher at 713-555-0119 immediately regarding gas pressure dropping below contract minimum, which may cause a unit to go offline.

Other updates
*   California utility costs: Confirming potential undercollection from direct access customers; details on Bucket #1 provided.
*   August Confirmations: Received attachments for Public Service Company of Colorado and Cheyenne Light, Power, Fuel & Power Company; please sign and return if in agreement.
